newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends up on technical adjustment.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends up on technical adjustment.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were quoted higher at the close on technical adjustment, with trading practically nil due to the absence of buyers.
Consumer demand was lacking as players were still in a holiday mood after the prolonged Chinese New Year, said traders, adding that serious activity was only expected next week.
"The market is still quiet as not everyone's back to work fully," said a trader.
At the close, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted March RSS1 buyer at 303.50 cents ($1.22) a kg, up 1.50 cents from Monday.
March SMR 20 rose a cent to 299 cents.
Traders offered the SMR 20 at 300 cents a kg, SMR CV at 361, SMR L at 341, SMR 10 at 301 and drum latex FOB at 240.
The INRO five-day average was 234.60 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on Feb 17 from 234.36 on Feb 14. The daily indicator was at 234.10 against 234.29.
